name: Okasare Yuusha IV ~Mou Dame. Boku no Ochinchin wa Genkai na no ni~

A world under invasion by monster girls.
You vow to liberate the people from fear, but the endless monsters and the demon lord are too powerful for a mere human.

In your travels you meet a succubus who can help you
